tickets.title: Cart totals show wrong price
tickets.description: formatPrice drops the second decimal digit for round dollar amounts, e.g. $1.00 shows as $1.0. Fix formatPrice in src/cart.js so prices always show two decimals.

tickets.title: Describe the cart in words
tickets.description: Add describeCart(items) to src/cart.js: it returns "Cart is empty" for no items, otherwise the total quantity as "1 item" or "N items".
criteria: one unit returns "1 item"; three units across two lines return "3 items"
